title: Source Record
description: A single source that evidence can cite. Created in Stage 01, referenced by sourceId everywhere else.

url.description: The exact URL a tool returned. Never invented.

publicationDate.description: ISO date if known, else null. Used for recency checks.

retrievedAt.description: ISO timestamp the source was fetched.

qualityTier.description: Per references/evidence-standards.md. A = authoritative, C = weak/promotional.
